```{r report-hero}
# Sample identity band. The clinical overview below it (gene-list chips, key findings,
# genome-wide biomarkers, sequencing cards) is _gene_filter.qmd + _overview.qmd; the
# "## Overview" heading here is what puts all three in one TOC entry.
mode_css = if (outputs$mode == "matched") "is-matched" else "is-tumour-only"
tags$header(
  class = "report-hero",
  # No eyebrow: Quarto's own title line directly above already says what this document is.
  div(class = "report-hero__title", params$sample_id),
  div(class = "report-hero__badges",
    tags$span(class = paste("report-badge", mode_css), toupper(outputs$mode)),
    tags$span(class = "report-badge is-meta", toupper(params$reference)),
    tags$span(class = "report-badge is-meta", toupper(params$sex)),
    # Light/dark toggle: script below; the stored choice is applied before first paint by the
    # include-in-header script of templates/per_sample.qmd (same storage key)
    tags$button(type = "button", class = "theme-toggle", `aria-pressed` = "false",
                title = "Switch between light and dark mode",
                tags$span(class = "theme-toggle__icon", `aria-hidden` = "true"),
                tags$span(class = "theme-toggle__label", "Dark mode"))
  ),
  tags$script(HTML('
(function () {
  var KEY = "lrsomatic-report-theme", root = document.documentElement;
  var btn = document.querySelector(".theme-toggle");
  if (!btn) return;
  var mq = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)") : null;
  function current() {
    var t = root.getAttribute("data-theme");
    return t === "dark" || t === "light" ? t : (mq && mq.matches ? "dark" : "light");
  }
  function sync() {
    var dark = current() === "dark";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", dark ? "true" : "false");
    btn.querySelector(".theme-toggle__label").textContent = dark ? "Light mode" : "Dark mode";
    btn.querySelector(".theme-toggle__icon").textContent = dark ? "\\u2600" : "\\u263E";
  }
  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var next = current() === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    root.setAttribute("data-theme", next);
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, next); } catch (e) {}
    sync();
  });
  if (mq && mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change", sync);
  sync();
})();'))
)
```
